Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single square 64x64 dialogue portrait source for a Xenogears fan game.
Image1 is the EXACT native Kislev guard sprite atlas and is the authority for this character's appearance. Image2 is native Xenogears dialogue portraits, for drawing style/framing only; ignore its grid/labels and do not copy another named character.
Create a faithful head-and-upper-chest interpretation of the guard visible in Image1. Study multiple visible head and torso pieces: compact dark charcoal/olive military helmet with a small red-orange side marking; conspicuous pale-rimmed rectangular goggles worn OVER THE EYES with dark lenses; slate-blue uniform with brighter blue shoulder/sleeve panels, dark webbing/harness, and small red-orange shoulder insignia. The native sprite has a blue cloth section at the lower face/neck: retain that blue covering and exposed tan skin wherever the sprite shows it. The guard must clearly read as blue-uniformed with goggles, not a generic green-uniform soldier with bare eyes. No bomb collar for this guard.
Match late-1990s Xenogears PlayStation anime portraits: clean dark contours, limited cel-shaded color shapes, no photoreal texture, restrained practical design, readable after native64 downsampling. Three-quarter view facing screen-right; helmet and head nearly fill frame, upper chest/shoulders at bottom. One character on pure solid black background; no text, border, grid, logos or UI. Preserve the reference sprite's distinctive dark helmet, goggles and BLUE uniform; do not substitute a modern tactical costume or helmet from another character.

entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / sprite-to-dialogue-portrait.
Transform the adult female NPC shown in images1 and2 (exact original game sprite head and neck crops) into a coherent illustrated dialogue portrait. Image3 is the complete sprite atlas for costume continuity. Image4 is the original game's Rico/Fei/Elly portraits; use it for tight face/neck framing, subdued 1998 Japanese RPG drawing style and proportions, not for character identity.
Character: Latina, the D Block bar host and Battler. Her sprite has salmon/dusty pink chin-length bobbed hair, heavy separated side fringe framing the face, short outward-turning side tufts, and a dark olive horizontal headband exposed across the upper forehead. Warm golden tan skin. Visible feminine face, uncovered nose mouth and chin, dark reddish-brown eyes; no glasses, no mask. A composed, familiar, slightly wry expression, very subtle closed-mouth smile.
Costume: a narrow dark olive/charcoal prisoner neck collar with separated small pale rectangular inserts matching the sprite. Only a small edge of the dark olive outfit at the lower corners. No white waitress blouse, apron, cap, earrings or invented accessories.
Composition: square CLOSE-UP FACE AND NECK portrait like reference4. Face takes most of the frame; pink hair naturally crops against top and sides, collar at bottom, barely any upper chest.
